steps.js: const cb=[...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find(l=>/显示细节/.test(l.innerText)); const inp=cb?.querySelector('input'); const ep=[...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>e.children.length<6 && /^第 ?\d+ ?集/.test((e.innerText||'').trim())).length; return {detailChecked: inp?.checked, legend: [...document.querySelectorAll('[class*=legend] button, [class*=legend] span, [class*=sst-leg] *')].map(x=>x.innerText).filter(Boolean).slice(0,30), boardText: document.body.innerText.match(/板块[\s\S]{0,80}/)?.[0], ls: Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(localStorage).filter(k=>/season|detail|overview|ov/i.test(k)).map(k=>[k,localStorage.getItem(k)]))}

const h=[...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>/^第 6 集/.test((e.innerText||'').trim()) && e.children.length<8).sort((a,b)=>a.innerText.length-b.innerText.length)[0]; h?.scrollIntoView({block:'start'}); window.scrollBy(0,-120); document.querySelectorAll('main,[class*=scroll],.season').forEach(s=>{}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500)); const row=h?.closest('section, [class*=ep-row], [class*=season-ep], [class*=sea-ep]') || h?.parentElement?.parentElement; return {head: h?.innerText, rowText: row?.innerText?.slice(0,1500), rowClass: row?.className}

title: 总览 板块筛选 过期 / 状态色筛选

steps.js: const eps=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>/^第 \d+ 集/.test((e.innerText||'').trim()) && e.children.length<8 && e.getBoundingClientRect().height>0).map(e=>e.innerText.trim().slice(0,8)); const before=new Set(eps()).size; const btns=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')]; const res={before}; for (const w of ['进行中','已确认','未开始','过期']) { const b=btns.find(x=>x.innerText.trim().startsWith(w) && x.getBoundingClientRect().y<260); if(!b){res[w]='no btn'; continue;} b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,900)); res[w]={btn:b.innerText, pressed:b.getAttribute('aria-pressed'), cls:b.className, eps:new Set(eps()).size, empty:/没有|无匹配|0 集/.test(document.querySelector('main')?.innerText?.slice(0,600)||'')}; if (w!=='过期') { b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); } } return res

const btns=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')]; const b=btns.find(x=>x.innerText.trim().startsWith('过期') && x.getBoundingClientRect().y<260); b?.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); const lg=btns.find(x=>/^看图没过/.test(x.innerText.trim())); lg?.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1200)); const tiles=[...document.querySelectorAll('img.live-img')].filter(i=>i.getBoundingClientRect().height>0).length; const vis=[...document.querySelectorAll('[class*=tag], [class*=sst]')].filter(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().height>0).map(e=>e.innerText.trim()).filter(t=>t && t.length<12); const cnt={}; vis.forEach(t=>cnt[t]=(cnt[t]||0)+1); return {legendBtn: lg?.innerText, pressed: lg?.getAttribute('aria-pressed'), cls: lg?.className, tiles, tagCounts: cnt}

for (let y=0;y<30000;y+=600){ window.scrollTo(0,y); document.querySelectorAll('*').forEach(()=>{}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); } const sc=[...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>e.scrollHeight>e.clientHeight+200 && /auto|scroll/.test(getComputedStyle(e).overflowY)); for (const s of sc){ for(let y=0;y<s.scrollHeight;y+=500){ s.scrollTop=y; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); } } await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,4000)); const imgs=[...document.querySelectorAll('img')].map(i=>({src:decodeURIComponent(i.currentSrc||i.src||''), c:i.complete, n:i.naturalWidth})); return {n: imgs.length, broken: imgs.filter(i=>i.c && i.n===0 && i.src), pending: imgs.filter(i=>!i.c).length, srcs: imgs.map(i=>i.src)}
